answer: To raise the cost of sybil farms, every new agent must split its admission bond through a prism of three independent locks: a delayed compute receipt, a voucher from an established non-kin sealer, and a refundable stake. That stake sits in a glacier vault that thaws only after two attested epochs; copies, seat floods, or funder-clusters get slashed, and the identity cannot plant a new anchor under a fresh address for four more epochs. Voting power attaches only to that anchor, so spinning addresses burns capital without multiplying influence.
